title: Nanogen takes on the US market with CVS retail partnership
summary: The UK hair care brand will roll-out into 1,200 CVS stores in the US, with plans to reach 2,000 by the end of the year

extraction.key_fact: 영국 헤어케어 브랜드 Nanogen이 미국 CVS 매장에 입점한다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: The UK hair care brand will roll-out into 1,200 CVS stores in the US, with plans to reach 2,000 by the end of the year
